FFR reports 351 October robot sales and shipments and a 100-city education plan

FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem, or FFR, said on November 12 that its acquired robotics business recorded 351 robot sales and shipments in October and 1,168 cumulatively through month-end. FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem ↗12 November 2026English editorial summary
Story

New operating figures

FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem, or FFR, said on November 12 that its acquired robotics business recorded 351 robot sales and shipments in October and 1,168 cumulatively through month-end. The combined “sales and shipments” measure should not be counted twice or interpreted as a tally of fully autonomous customer deployments.

Separate pre-acquisition accounts

The acquired business reported approximately $2.3 million in nine-month revenue and $593,000 in gross profit, around 26%. These are unaudited standalone combined figures. The acquisition closed on October 23, after quarter-end, so these results are excluded from FFR’s consolidated third-quarter accounts.

Education and platform plans

FFR plans a 100-city robotics education initiative and a Physical Cloud introduction around CES. Brain Blocks has added AI and motion recording/playback, while the FF Nova simulation sandbox remains in beta. Future expansion and service plans need to be separated from available features and reported revenue.
